notes: limits.py holds plain SIGN_IN_LIMIT and DEMO_ADDRESS_LIMIT constants, read only by sign_in_limited and demo_limited, so M1 and M5 change them. There is no request-level client-key function: each view passes request.META['REMOTE_ADDR'] to limits.lock_sign_in or limits.lock_demo, so M3 edits both call sites in views.py to pass the first X-Forwarded-For entry when present. views.sign_in locks the counter, checks sign_in_limited, authenticates and records a failure inside limit_transaction: M2 authenticates first and checks the limit only for a failure, and M4 zeroes and saves the locked counter on success (the lock statement restarts the window of a zero count).
